tasks.label: Machine.App: Remove debug package
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $project = Join-Path $env:MACHINE_WORKSPACE_ROOT 'src\Machine.App\Machine.App.csproj'; $manifest = Join-Path $env:MACHINE_WORKSPACE_ROOT 'src\Machine.App\bin\Debug\net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0\win-x64\AppxManifest.xml'; $cliOutput = @(& dotnet msbuild $project -getProperty:WinAppCliPath -property:Configuration=Debug -property:RuntimeIdentifier=win-x64); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $cli = ($cliOutput | Select-Object -Last 1).Trim(); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cli)) { throw 'The project WinApp CLI was not found.' }; & $cli unregister --manifest $manifest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -lt 50 -and (Get-Process -Name 'Machine.App' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $attempt++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }; if (Get-Process -Name 'Machine.App' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Machine.App is still running after debug cleanup.' }
